title: stateTests
responsibility: Attributes authored committed test files to a unit state using registered scenarios and existing dependency attribution, excluding skipped and fixture-only mentions.

inputs.name: stateTests.context
inputs.description: Guidance context whose loaded file index and scenarios select the candidate tests, with its graph, attribution and test-syntax caches filled during the call. The graph is built only when context.graph is absent, and attribution and syntax results are cached per unit and per file within that context.

inputs.name: stateTests.unit
inputs.description: Unit manifest whose id selects the scenarios that list it and prefixes its scenario state names, and which is passed whole to dependency attribution. A unit that no scenario lists in its units gets no scenario-declared files, but its dependency-attributed test files are still considered.

examples.title: Evidence grid
examples.responsibility: Shows a report's captured evidence as a responsive grid of image tiles.

inputs.name: stateTests.state
inputs.description: The state name to attribute, compared by exact string equality with the unit-level name of each required scenario state and with the string literals in candidate test files. A scenario state id loses the unit's id prefix, with dots turned into dashes, and the bare prefix means 'default'; an id without that prefix is compared unchanged.

outputs.name: stateTests
outputs.description: Authored test files that exist in the loaded index and contain a test or it call that is not skipped or todo, plus either the state as a string literal or, when a matching scenario whose tests resolve to the file declares viewports, one of the identifiers catalogCases, previewVariants, variants, previewState or state. Each viewports list holds the viewport IDs of the matching scenarios whose tests resolve to that file, and is empty when only dependency attribution found it.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: Propagates any error thrown or rejected by guidanceText, graphOf or testAttribution unchanged; stateTests has no try/catch, so a failure never becomes an empty or passing result.
